{"text":"[PROGRAM 1]

SIGNALS OBSERVED: Random parents and up to four random contexts; labels were unused (DIVERGE_LABEL 0, REFINE_LABEL 0; no child scores). Best stayed 0.9297 through 11 stagnant iterations; median fell to 0.9261.

WHAT SEEMED TO HELP (ONLY LIST WHAT HELPED): Lower-scoring parents often improved, reaching 0.9274, especially with mixed-score contexts.

POTENTIAL KEY INSIGHT: Neither child surpassed the seed nor 0.01 improvement; unused labels during prolonged stagnation were a missed opportunity."}
